ModMetadata.Name: Cable Labels
ModMetadata.Author: erica-kretsch
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Cable Labels[/h1]
A label for cables, like the vanilla pipe label but thinner. Place it on a straight stretch of cable with the Pipe Label kit (cycle to the cable label), then name it with the Labeller.
Idea by Kastuk.
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*]Needed on the host and every client. [*]Removing the mod from a save removes any cable labels placed in it. [/list]
This is a [b]StationeersLaunchPad[/b] mod. It requires BepInEx. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
